sample.task:
(Sayori wakes up in her room. She’s still alive and well. Were the events of DDLC just a dream? And as she saw a fly buzzing around, she suddenly unleashed a long tongue - she was part Chameleos! She got up and walked to the door. But with just a touch, the door was sent flying into the wall. It looked like Sayori was also part Kushala Daora. She stepped into a strange container - not only did she contain DNA of Chameleos and Kushala Daora, but she also contained DNA of Teostra and Vaal Hazak, even though she still looked like her normal self. But as she stepped outside her house, she saw...Monika! But she was floating - she was completely white all over, and her entire body looked transparent...as if she had become a ghost. But Sayori still looked the same.)

Sayori: "M-Monika…you look like a ghost!"

(Monika’s expression saddened, and she turned blue - but...she also started crying, maybe after the digital world and real world had merged.)

Sayori: "Monika, what’s wrong? Why do you look like a ghost?"

Monika: "I...I am a ghost, Sayori. But how I perished was…shocking. It didn’t have something to do with being hung…or getting stabbed…or having my neck snapped…or getting deleted from all reality."

(Monika gestured to her stomach - and the remainders of an umbilical cord were visible inside, and her belly had blood-like writing that read "My baby was here".)

Sayori: "Oh my goodness...Monika, how did you die?"
sample.chosen:
Monika: "I was pregnant, Sayori. I gave birth to a child, but it was stillborn. The pain of losing my child was too much for me to bear. I couldn't cope with the reality of it, and I took my own life. I became a ghost, trapped in this world, unable to move on."

Sayori: "I'm so sorry, Monika. I can't imagine how painful that must have been. But I'm here now, and I'm determined to help you."

Monika: "Thank you, Sayori. I don't know if there's anything you can do to bring me back to life, but I appreciate your concern. I just wish I could be there for my child, even in this form."

Sayori: "Monika, I believe that every life has meaning, no matter how it ends. Your child may have been with you only for a short time, but they left an impact on this world. And you, Monika, have been a friend to me and to so many others. You're not just a ghost, you're a part of our lives, and we'll do whatever we can to help you find peace."
